O place and greatness, millions of false eyes
Duke, O Place and Greatness! Millions of false eyes are stuck upon thee. Volumes of
report run with these false and most contrarious quests sixty upon thy doings. Thousand escapes
of wit make thee the father of their idle dreams, and rack thee in their fancies.
